records.title: Illustrative WGS84 Earth presentation
assumptions: WGS84 ellipsoid dimensions; mesh is a tessellated approximation.
Fixed artistic light direction and atmosphere shell.
records.uncertainty: No physical atmosphere, terrain or hazard result is calculated.
limitations: Not a terrain surface or measured illumination model.
records.attribution: Doom Map authored presentation; ellipsoid constants from WGS84.
records.coverage: Global ellipsoid only; no regional terrain detail.
